fields.name: crossings
fields.description: Number of times, since t=0 and up to and including the scene at this decision step, that the cube's x-coordinate has moved from one side of the target's x-coordinate to the other (a crossing happens between two consecutive observed frames when the sign of cube_x minus target_x flips; being near the target without flipping is not a crossing). Each crossing is one arrival of the cube at the target. At step #1 the value is 0. It increases only at the step whose observed frames contain the flip. e.g. 2

fields.name: cube_side
fields.description: Which side of the target line the cube is on in the scene at this decision step (the last frame shown): 'smaller_x' if cube_x < target_x, 'larger_x' if cube_x > target_x. At step #1 it is read from the t=0 frame. e.g. larger_x

fields.name: peak_speed
fields.description: The fastest cube speed observed so far, in pixels of x per timestep. For every pair of consecutive frames shown at the same decision step (do not pair a frame with one shown at a different step), from step #1 up to and including this decision step, compute |cube_x(later) - cube_x(earlier)| divided by the number of timesteps between the two frames; write the largest such value seen so far, rounded to one decimal. At step #1 there is only one frame, so write 0. The value never decreases; it grows only at a step whose shown frames contain a faster pair than any seen before. e.g. 3.8
